package.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。

en-US.description: A desktop AI companion that connects any model, does the work itself, and delegates specialist jobs to coding agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Nomi is an AI companion living on your desktop: bring any model, let it do the work, and let it hand specialist jobs to specialist AIs. Models, coding agents, MCP and local tools all connect in one place, coordinated by Nomi.
Connect a model once and every AI can use it: after adding a provider, Nomi itself plus Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok and dsh can use any of its models, or everything can switch to local models. The local gateway detects and translates between Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions and Gemini generateContent, so streaming, tool calls, reasoning, images and context compaction keep working.
Tasks can be limited to specific folders, coding assistants get a two-column workspace, and the desktop mascot shows speech and confirmation bubbles. The app runs on a Go core with the native WebView, installs per user without administrator rights, and needs the Edge WebView2 runtime, which is usually preinstalled on Windows 10 and 11.

zh-CN.description: 桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己干活，也能把专业的活派给编程助手。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Nomi 是住在你桌面上的 AI 伙伴：接上任意模型，自己动手干活，也会把专业的活派给专业的 AI。模型、编程助手、MCP 与本地工具都接到一处，由 Nomi 统一调度。
模型只接一次就能给所有 AI 使用：添加一次供应商，Nomi 自己和 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok、dsh 都能用它的任意模型，也可以全部换成本地模型。本机网关自动识别并互转 Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses、OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Gemini generateContent，流式、工具调用、推理、图片和上下文压缩都照常工作。
任务可以限定能访问的文件夹，编程助手有独立的两栏工作区，桌面角色会显示台词与确认气泡。应用为 Go 内核加原生 WebView，单个安装包约 39 MB，按当前用户安装，不需要管理员权限。
zh-CN.name: Nomi
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Nomi· 诺米 2.3.8
工作区改为「项目」：一个项目可以放多个文件夹，跨端工程的前端、后端、文档放在一起；分叉合成一个弹窗，每条回复末尾都能从这里分叉。 / Workspaces become projects: one project can hold several folders, so a product's frontend, backend and docs live together; forking is one dialog, and every reply can be forked from.
新功能 / New
- 项目可以包含多个文件夹：其中一个是主文件夹（工作目录、git 和 AGENTS.md 以它为准），其余文件夹 Nomi 和编程助手同样能读写 / A project can hold several folders: one is the primary folder (the working directory; git and AGENTS.md come from it), and Nomi and coding agents can read and write the others too
- 侧栏「项目」标题上的按钮打开「创建项目」，不再直接开对话；项目上的「…」可以改名、增删文件夹、换主文件夹或移除项目（只移除记录，不删文件） / The button on the sidebar's Projects header opens "Create project" instead of starting a chat; a project's "…" menu renames it, adds or removes folders, changes the primary folder, or removes the project (only the entry, never your files)
- 新会话、新建菜单和分叉都可以选项目；改了项目的文件夹，已有会话下一轮起就按新的文件夹工作 / New chats, the new-chat menu and forks let you pick a project; when a project's folders change, existing chats use the new folders from their next turn
- 右栏「改动」按 git 仓库分段，每段有自己的分支、暂存和提交；「文件」每个文件夹一个节点；输入框里 @ 引用路径覆盖所有文件夹 / In the side panel, Changes shows one section per git repository with its own branch, staging and commit; Files shows one node per folder; @ paths in the input cover every folder
- 分叉合成一个弹窗：分叉到新会话或其他端、带入几轮上下文、放进哪个项目都在一处选 / Forking is one dialog: a new session or another endpoint, how many turns to carry and which project, all in one place
- 每条回复末尾新增「从这里分叉」：只带到这条回复为止，之后的消息不带，原会话不受影响 / Each reply has "Fork from here": it carries messages up to that reply only and leaves later ones out; the original chat is unchanged
修复 / Fixes
- 沙箱里的编程助手不能再改版本管理器的命令入口（~/.pyenv/shims、rbenv、asdf、mise、Volta 等），工具的日志和缓存照常能写（#302） / Coding agents in the sandbox can no longer change version-manager command entries (~/.pyenv/shims, rbenv, asdf, mise, Volta…); tool logs and caches stay writable (#302)
- 用第三方供应商的 MiniMax Code 标签用的是标签自己的网关令牌：思考深度、模型和用量都对得上这个标签，关掉标签后旧令牌作废（#301） / MiniMax Code tabs on a third-party provider use their own gateway token, so effort, model and usage match the tab, and the old token stops working once the tab closes (#301)
- macOS 上关闭 Rive 动画后，静态形象第一次显示、重新打开显示或从 Rive 切回时不再空白，不用再调整大小（#303） / On macOS with Rive animation off, the static character no longer shows up blank on first display, after turning it back on or when switching from Rive; no resize needed (#303)
变化 / Changes
- 升级后第一次启动时，以前用过的每个工作目录各建成一个项目，会话照旧归在里面 / On the first launch after updating, each working directory you used before becomes a project, with its chats still in it
- 分叉可选的轮数去掉了「最近 1 轮」 / The fork turn choices no longer include "last 1 turn"
- 会话列表出现滚动条时内容不再左右跳动 / The chat list no longer shifts sideways when its scrollbar appears
